context: Cancellation half done: #3056 (3d7aaf854, 2026-10-16) removed the oracle-review concurrency group. Each run now checks that its head is still the PR head before and after it runs, and fails closed; workflow tests were updated. Residual risk: overlapping runs can finish out of order. Owner, 2026-10-16, question dialog: "Fix both now" (cancellation race and quota classification; the latter is #3058). Not done: the oracle-verdict 'Rerun the failed synchronize suite' step (.github/workflows/oracle-verdict.yml, around lines 2026-2035) still reruns every failed run for the head and fails on runs that cannot be retried (#3049, run 38938627249). If that half belongs elsewhere, split it into a new item and finish this one.
description: After an oracle success verdict, the oracle-review run triggered by that verdict is often cancelled by a concurrent pull_request (or edited/synchronize) run in the same concurrency group. The cancelled check row leaves the PR BLOCKED until someone manually re-runs that specific run. Seen on #2993, #3006, #3004 and others. The existing automatic re-run after a late verdict does not cover this case.
